run:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads an even-length sequence of integers, splits it by parity into two groups, finds the most frequent value in each group, and outputs the minimum number of elements to change so the two final chosen parity values differ, using second-best alternatives when the two modes coincide." run]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the first line as integer n and the second line as string line, treating line as the source of all integers to process. RESULT n, line]
            [COMMAND Initialize arrays seqA and seqB of length n/2, tokenizer state offset=0 and next=0, delimiter character regx=' ', empty frequency maps mapA/mapB, and empty distinct-value lists listA/listB. RESULT seqA, seqB, offset, next, regx, mapA, mapB, listA, listB]
            [COMMAND In a loop over i from 0 to n-1, extract the next token from line by setting next to the next space from offset, or to line.length() if none exists, then parse line.substring(offset, next) as an integer and set offset to next+1. RESULT token, offset]
            [COMMAND In the same loop with j equal to i >> 1, if i is even store the parsed token in seqA[j], otherwise store it in seqB[j]; after storing, increment the corresponding frequency in mapA or mapB and add the value to listA or listB the first time it is seen. RESULT seqA, seqB, mapA, mapB, listA, listB]
            [COMMAND Initialize vma, vmb, xa, and xb to 0, then select xa as the value in listA with the largest mapA frequency and xb as the value in listB with the largest mapB frequency, using strict greater-than so earlier list order wins ties. RESULT vma, xa, vmb, xb]
            [COMMAND Initialize cca and ccb to 0, then count cca as the number of elements in seqA not equal to xa and ccb as the number of elements in seqB not equal to xb. RESULT cca, ccb]
            [COMMAND If xa differs from xb, set ans to cca + ccb. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND If xa equals xb, initialize vma2, vmb2, xa2, and xb2 to 0, then find the best alternative value xa2 in listA excluding xa and the best alternative value xb2 in listB excluding xb by their frequencies; if no alternative exists, the sentinel 0 remains. RESULT vma2, xa2, vmb2, xb2]
            [COMMAND In the xa equals xb case, compute cca2 as the number of seqA elements different from xa2 and ccb2 as the number of seqB elements different from xb2. RESULT cca2, ccb2]
            [COMMAND In the xa equals xb case, set ans to cca + ccb2 if cca2 is greater than ccb2, otherwise set ans to cca2 + ccb. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Write the value of ans as a line to standard output. RESULT void]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: An IOException is thrown while reading input or closing the BufferedReader]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Catch the IOException in the catch block and print its stack trace to System.err, then terminate the method without printing ans. RESULT void]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
